show_notification.text: 'EOC INITIALIZING — please wait approximately 10 seconds before opening EOC.'

set_value.name: $profile
set_value.exact: table[$station=$station, $stationname=$directory.$stationname, $role='UNDEFINED', $rolesource='PLAYER REQUIRED', $firstseen=player.age, $lastseen=player.age, $samples=0, $overall='MONITORING', $trend='STABLE', $active=0, $recurring=0, $chronic=0, $critical=0, $recovering=0, $resolved=0, $relapsed=0, $confidence='INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE', $historyhits=0, $recommendation='Assign a station role before strategic interpretation', $priority='NOTE', $prompted=false]

set_value.name: $profile.$resources
set_value.exact: 'Tracked through bounded shortage, supply and storage evidence'

set_value.name: $profile.$overall
set_value.exact: if $profile.$critical gt 0 then 'CRITICAL' else if $profile.$chronic gt 0 then 'CHRONIC' else if $profile.$relapsed gt 0 then 'RELAPSED' else if $profile.$recurring gt 0 then 'RECURRING' else if $profile.$recovering gt 0 then 'RECOVERING' else if $profile.$resolved gt 0 then 'RESOLVED' else if $profile.$active gt 0 then 'TRANSIENT' else 'MONITORING'

set_value.name: $profile.$trend
set_value.exact: if $profile.$critical gt 0 or $profile.$chronic gt 0 then 'DETERIORATING' else if $profile.$relapsed gt 0 then 'RELAPSED' else if $profile.$recovering gt 0 then 'IMPROVING' else 'STABLE'

set_value.name: $profile.$confidence
set_value.exact: if $profile.$samples ge 12 and $profile.$historyhits ge 18 then 'HIGH' else if $profile.$samples ge 3 then 'MEDIUM' else 'LOW'

set_value.name: $profile.$priority
set_value.exact: if $profile.$critical gt 0 then 'CRITICAL' else if $profile.$chronic gt 0 then 'WARNING' else if $profile.$active gt 0 then 'NOTE' else 'INFO'

show_notification.text: 'CRITICAL: %1 requires immediate operational review. Open its Executive Advisor report for evidence and next actions.'.[$profile.$stationname]

set_value.name: $profile.$recommendation
set_value.exact: if $profile.$role == 'UNDEFINED' then 'Assign the station role; EOC will not infer strategic intent silently' else if $profile.$active == 0 then 'Continue monitoring; no strategic intervention is supported' else if $directory.$shipcount == 0 then 'Review existing unassigned mining and trade ships before considering new construction' else if $profile.$role == 'MINING' or $profile.$role == 'MINING HUB' then 'Review mining coverage, resource probes, storage headroom and refinery demand' else if $profile.$role == 'TRADE / DISTRIBUTION' or $profile.$role == 'TRADING HUB' then 'Review trader coverage, ware allocations and trade-policy reach' else if $profile.$role == 'SHIPYARD' or $profile.$role == 'WHARF' then 'Protect construction supply, workforce and operational ship capacity' else if $profile.$role == 'FACTORY' then 'Review production inputs, output flow and logistics support' else if $profile.$role == 'FOOD' then 'Protect workforce-input continuity and container-storage margin' else if $profile.$role == 'DEFENSE' then 'Preserve defense readiness; avoid interpreting reserve stock as commercial excess' else if $profile.$role == 'TECHNOLOGY' then 'Prioritize high-tier input continuity and suitable trade support' else if $profile.$role == 'HEADQUARTERS' then 'Review mixed-purpose dependencies before changing infrastructure' else 'Review recurring evidence by function; reassign existing ships before recommending new construction'

show_notification.text: 'NOTE: EOC has not been told what %1 does. Select the station and open Executive Advisor to assign its persistent role.'.[$profile.$stationname]

add_player_choice_sub.text: 'INFO: EOC CAN CLASSIFY UNDEFINED STATIONS FROM VERIFIED OPERATIONAL EVIDENCE. THE PLAYER MAY CHANGE ANY ROLE LATER.'

set_value.name: $evidence
set_value.exact: 'No specialized function was proven; safe general role selected'

write_to_logbook.title: 'EOC Automatic Station Role — %1'.[$profile.$stationname]
write_to_logbook.text:
'Assigned role: %1
Evidence: %2
Trigger: %3

The player may change this role at any time through Station Role Assignment.'.[$role, $evidence, global.$JKEOC_B83DAutoRoleReason]

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B83D][ROLE_AUTO_ASSIGNED] station=%1 role=%2 source=%3 evidence=%4 trigger=%5'.[$profile.$stationname, $role, $source, $evidence, global.$JKEOC_B83DAutoRoleReason]

show_notification.text: 'ACTION: EOC assigned %1 undefined station role(s). INFO: Each assignment and its evidence were saved to Tips. Roles remain player-editable.'.[$assigned]

add_player_choice_sub.text: 'ACTION: ROLE AUTOMATION | UNDEFINED: %1 | PAGE %2 OF %3'.[global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined, global.$JKEOC_B69RolePage + 1, $pages]

set_value.name: global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined
set_value.exact: if global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined gt 0 then global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined - 1 else 0

show_notification.text: 'ACTION: %1 saved for %2. INFO: Undefined Roles: %3'.[global.$JKEOC_B69PendingRole, global.$JKEOC_B69SelectedProfile.$stationname, global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined]

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B69][ROLE_SAVED] station=%1 role=%2 index=%3 page=%4 undefined=%5'.[global.$JKEOC_B69SelectedProfile.$stationname, global.$JKEOC_B69PendingRole, global.$JKEOC_B69RoleIndex, global.$JKEOC_B69RolePage + 1, global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined]

show_notification.text: 'ACTION: Station role assignment complete. INFO: Undefined Roles: 0.'

do_if.value: not global.$JKEOC_B67SelectedProfile? and $profile.$role == 'UNDEFINED' and $profile.$station.exists and $profile.$station.owner == faction.player

show_notification.text: 'ACTION: Station role classification complete. INFO: No undefined stations remain; classified station roles can still be changed from their station advisor.'
'ACTION: Executive analysis complete. INFO: Persistent station profiles updated.'

add_player_choice_sub.text: 'NOTE: SELECT A STATION IN BROWSE ALL STATIONS FIRST'

set_value.exact: if global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined gt 0 then global.$JKEOC_B67Undefined - 1 else 0
